verdict.rationale: CoreWeave exposes Terraform/OpenTofu IaC, a CKS REST API, kubectl/kubeconfig access, and an Inference API with generated clients across multiple languages, all of which support headless/CI automation of cluster and inference workflows. However, there's no explicit CI/CD pipeline integration guide (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI examples) or dedicated CLI tool documented, and no independent evidence confirming real-world headless CI usage. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD pipeline examples (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI), a first-party CLI tool for scripting, and independent/community confirmation of headless automation workflows.
